title: RPG Series Mods Chinese Translation Resource
description: Provide the Chinese translation for RPG Series.
body:
Providing Chinese translations for RPG Series mods of the Prominence II modpack, the resources created by the VM Chinese Translation Group. The translated mods are as follows:

Archer

Death Knights

Invocations

Paladins & Priests

Ranged Weapon API

Rogues & Warriors

Spell Engine

Spellblades and Such
